# Recorded Open Prices responses

Source: https://prices.openfoodfacts.org/api/v1/ (exact request URL in each JSON).
Retrieved 2026-10-24. Attribution: Open Prices (Open Food Facts), ODbL.
These are observations, not a current catalog. Spanish coverage is sparse and old.
Contributor identifiers, proof data and coordinates were removed by the parent.
Do not combine these observations with non-free data into a redistributed database.
